## Narrow chosen change

Replace **only fresh control observation/decoding** in storage/fp_environment.py: glibc2.41 publicfegetmode(femode_t*) with a fresh, owned, call-local ctypes.Structure containing unsigned-short CW, unsigned-short reserved, unsigned-int MXCSR. Preserve read_controls()->Controls field names/order, require_masked mask-only predicate, require_supported full predicate, exception family/chaining, every existing target admission check, every public/private guard position, current six/query and seven/query_json fresh reads, and independently public readiness/codec behavior. Cache only immutable library/function/ABI binding, never a successful state observation or shared scratch owner.

Admit the mode ABI explicitly: sizeof8, alignment4, CWoffset0/MXCSRoffset4 (reservedoffset2), native ushort2/uint4 and all existing Linuxx86-64/little-endianLP64/glibc2.41/CPython/IEEE checks. The exact test runtime staysCPython3.12.14 and genuineDuckDB2.0.0. Do not silently narrow/widen public runtime admission beyond the selected existing checks merely from the tested version. Bind libm.so.6's publicfegetmode, retain native nonzero-return checks and domain-error translation. Missing symbol/library, bad layout/type/bind/read fails closed; no blind fallback, host repair or permissive zero-state default.

[Public mode source](https://github.com/bminor/glibc/blob/glibc-2.41/sysdeps/x86_64/fpu/fegetmode.c), [public x86 mode type](https://github.com/bminor/glibc/blob/glibc-2.41/sysdeps/x86/fpu/bits/fenv.h#L94-L106), [GNU mode contract](https://sourceware.org/glibc/manual/2.41/html_node/Control-Functions.html), [pinned ctypes scalar fields/foreign-call ownership](https://github.com/python/cpython/blob/v3.12.14/Modules/_ctypes/cfield.c).

**Compatibility decision:** the supported contract is fresh control-word observation and no application repair/control-register writes, not architectural preservation of every bit of the whole x87 environment. Intel defines FNSTCW's C0/C1/C2/C3 as undefined. All observed full statuses were equal, but tests do not strengthen that instruction contract. Keep this caveat explicit; do not claim whole-fenv equivalence. Current APIs return only CW/MXCSR, intentionally ignore x87 condition/sticky/precision bits for admission, and do not promise preservation of caller condition-code sequences across C calls. A caller needing a stronger condition-code contract needs a separately selected conservative fegetenv-decoding-only route; this trial does not silently provide one. [Intel SDM2A instruction reference](https://www.intel.com/content/dam/www/public/us/en/documents/manuals/64-ia-32-architectures-software-developer-vol-2a-manual.pdf#page=491).

There is no atomic snapshot against hostile same-thread mode mutation between the two control-register stores. Compatible controls/trusted-callee continuity remains required, including connection cleanup and caller encoders; native signal faults are not caught by Python exception wrapping. Byref and frame references keep each unpublished local owner alive through decoding; GIL release does not move the call to another OS thread, but does not establish callback freedom. No global/threadlocal/query-leased scratch, PyDLL/GIL switch, machine-code stub, private Python-object memory access or optional production native helper.

## Explicitly deferred/rejected alternatives

- **No guard removal or deduplication.** Getter-close/mode changes, public physical_bytes/inherited postcommit cleanup, native fetch, eager-conversion GC and query_json's dynamic query override make unconditional removal unproved. All6/7 guards stay.
- Retaining fegetenv with one combined unpack or typed overlay remains a conservative valid alternative, not falsely ruled out. It retains32-byte observation/save-restore and its own proof obligations; not bundled with this trial.
- **No per-cell codec change in this candidate.** Parallel fresh codec/vectorization research investigates duplicate key admission and immutable schema-set hoisting, with shared payload/domain validation and public subtype/hook ordering preserved. Preserve that separate research now; selecting/implementing it is deferred until this reader-only result is known. Do not rewrite typed_store.py25e9a4f… while measuring this trial.
- No native C++/browser/schema/legacy/SQL-engine/ABI/header/compiler-flag change. Actual unstable DuckDB CAPIv2 and logical td_query_v2 remain separate version axes.
